/usr/bin/dash.version: dash: Small and fast POSIX-compliant shell

array_all.label: "${arr[@]}" expands one word per element
array_all.snippet: arr=(a b c) || exit 9; set -- "${arr[@]}"; printf '%s\n' "$#"

glob_nomatch.label: a glob with no match stays literal

glob_nomatch_for.label: for over a glob with no match runs once with the pattern
glob_nomatch_for.snippet: n=0; for f in /definitely/not/here/*.xyz; do n=$((n+1)); done; printf '%s\n' "$n"

pipe_read.label: read at the end of a pipeline runs in a subshell

alias_in_script.label: aliases are not expanded in scripts

assoc_declare.label: declare -A associative arrays
assoc_declare.snippet: declare -A m || exit 9; m[key]=v || exit 9; printf '%s\n' "${m[key]}"

local_in_func.snippet: f() { local x=1 || exit 9; printf '%s\n' "$x"; }; f

getopts.label: getopts
getopts.snippet: set -- -a; getopts a o || exit 9; printf '%s\n' "$o"

last_pipe_status.label: $? after a pipeline is the last command

printf_basic.label: printf with width, alignment and zero-pad

shift_n.label: shift n drops n positional parameters
shift_n.snippet: set -- a b c d; shift 2 || exit 9; printf '%s\n' "$*"

until_loop.label: until loop runs while the test fails
until_loop.snippet: n=0; until [ "$n" -ge 3 ]; do n=$((n+1)); done; printf '%s\n' "$n"

case_basic.label: case with | alternatives and ;;
case_basic.snippet: x=b2; case $x in a*) r=A;; b*|c*) r=BC;; *) r=other;; esac; printf '%s\n' "$r"

test_t.label: [ -t 0 ] tests whether stdin is a terminal
test_t.snippet: if [ -t 0 ]; then printf 'tty\n'; else printf 'notty\n'; fi

case_fallthrough_amp.label: ;& falls through to the next case (bash 4)
case_fallthrough_amp.snippet: case a in a) printf 'a' ;& b) printf 'b\n' ;; esac

declare_g.label: declare -g global from inside a function
declare_g.snippet: f() { declare -g gv=1 || exit 9; }; f; printf '%s\n' "${gv:-unset}"

wait_n.label: wait -n waits for the next job (bash 4.3)

read_upper_n.label: read -N reads exactly N chars, IFS ignored
read_upper_n.snippet: printf 'ab cd' | { read -N 3 v || exit 9; printf '[%s]\n' "$v"; }

array_var_index.label: ${arr[$i]} indexes from 0
array_var_index.snippet: a=(x y z) || exit 9; i=1; printf '%s\n' "${a[$i]}"

dbl_bracket_neq_pattern.label: [[ x != pattern ]] matches a glob
dbl_bracket_neq_pattern.snippet: x=hello; [[ $x != h* ]]; case $? in 0) printf 'literal\n';; 1) printf 'pattern\n';; *) exit 9;; esac

array_star_ifs.label: "${arr[*]}" joins with the first IFS char
array_star_ifs.snippet: a=(x y z) || exit 9; IFS=-; printf '%s\n' "${a[*]}"

c_style_for.label: for ((i=0; i<n; i++)) loops
c_style_for.snippet: n=0; for ((i=0; i<3; i++)); do n=$((n+i)); done; printf '%s\n' "$n"

trap_exit_in_function.label: trap EXIT set inside a function

read_reply.label: read with no name fills REPLY

read_d_null.label: read -d '' reads up to NUL
read_d_null.snippet: printf 'ab\ncd' | { IFS= read -r -d '' v; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 1 ] || exit 9; printf '%s\n' "${#v}"; }

local_masks_status.label: local x=$(cmd) hides the command status

export_masks_status.label: export x=$(cmd) hides the command status

set_e_function_or.label: set -e ignored in a function under ||
set_e_function_or.snippet: set -e; f() { false; printf 'x\n'; }; f || true; printf 'ok\n'

declare_a.label: declare -a indexed array
declare_a.snippet: declare -a arr || exit 9; arr[1]=x; arr[2]=y; printf '%s\n' "${#arr[@]}"

unset_f.label: unset -f removes a function
unset_f.snippet: f() { printf 'fn\n'; }; unset -f f || exit 9; f 2>/dev/null || printf 'gone\n'

unset_array_element.label: unset arr[i] removes an element
unset_array_element.snippet: arr=(a b c) || exit 9; unset 'arr[1]' || exit 9; printf '%s\n' "${#arr[@]}"

shopt_extglob.label: shopt -s extglob @(a|b) patterns
shopt_extglob.snippet: shopt -s extglob || exit 9; eval 'case ab in @(ab|cd)) r=yes;; *) r=no;; esac'; printf '%s\n' "$r"
